Younger wife of Śrī Advaita Ācārya; sister of Sītā Ṭhākurāṇī and daughter of Nṛsiṁha Bhāḍuḍī; married with her sister at Phuliyā. Her son was Śyāmadāsa (Prema-vilāsa 24). When her own newborn son died, Sītā gave her second son Kṛṣṇadāsa (Kṛṣṇa Miśra) to her to bring up (Advaita-prakāśa 11; Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna).

In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: a manifestation (prakāśa) of Yogamāyā (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 86).

The record «Śrī» #1431 (wife of Advaita, Yogamāyā, Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 86; son Śyāmadāsa) was the same person and was joined to this one (07-11-2026).
